title: Juicy Fermented Spicy Malaysian Tomato Stir-fry
description: A revitalizing and comforting dish perfect for a sick day, this fiery tomato stir-fry combines fermented vegetables with spicy red peppers to create a plant-based delight.

ingredients.name: fermented vegetables (e.g., fermented tofu or pickled vegetables)
fish sauce (or soy sauce for a vegan option)

instructions: Heat a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add vegetable oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Chop tomatoes, red bell pepper into strips, and finely chop jalapeno peppers if using. Finely slice ginger and garlic cloves.
Add fermented vegetables to the hot pan, followed by chopped tomato slices and red bell pepper strips. Stir well for about 2 minutes.
Add finely chopped jalapenos (if using) and stir again for another minute until peppers start to soften.
Sprinkle in sliced ginger and minced garlic, then add salt and soy sauce or fish sauce, continuing to stir for a couple more seconds to combine flavors.
Increase heat to high. Add the chopped red bell pepper and tomatoes to the wok, stirring frequently as it begins to cook down.
Once everything is nicely combined and slightly cooked, remove from heat and sprinkle with fresh coriander leaves. Serve hot.
